```{r}
data(grey_seal_data)

elpd_lfo_out <- c()
for (year in 2010:2020) {

fit <- fit_ipm(
  grey_seal_data,
  "grey",
  years = 2005:(year - 1),
  iter_warmup = 100,
  iter_sampling = 100
)

forecast <- forecast_ipm(
   fit, 
   grey_seal_data,
   future_years = year
)

year_elpd_lfo <- elpd_lfo(forecast)
elpd_lfo_out <- c(elpd_lfo_out, year_elpd_lfo)
}



```
